description.value: Cycle Therapy is Duncan's full-service bicycle shop carrying Trek, Rocky Mountain, Pivot Cycles, Brodie, and Electra bikes, with a strong emphasis on e-bikes across multiple categories. As a Trek-certified and Shimano-certified service center, the shop's mechanics bring over 40 combined years of riding and wrenching experience and will work on any brand. Touring cyclists will find a well-stocked accessories section, professional bike fitting, rentals, and an active cycling club with local group rides.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and provides strong evidence. The service page confirms mechanics with 40+ combined years of experience who work on any brand, and the shop is a Trek-certified and Shimano-certified service center. Address (360 Duncan St., Duncan, BC V9L 3W4) and phone (250-597-0097) are corroborated on both the homepage and contact page, confirming OSM contact fields that were otherwise blank. Rentals and a cycling club with local rides are explicitly listed in the site's Services navigation.
concerns: OSM record had no address or phone; both were sourced from the website (360 Duncan St., 250-597-0097) and should be added to the OSM node.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, certified full-service bike shop in Duncan serving all rider types with repairs, rentals, e-bikes, fitting, and group rides — clearly valuable to touring cyclists passing through the Cowichan Valley.

E-bike service.detail: Shop sells e-bikes across road, gravel, mountain, hybrid, and cruiser categories and stocks e-bike batteries/kits; service page states mechanics work on any brand, implying e-bike service is covered

Bike rentals.detail: 'Rentals' listed as a dedicated service in the site navigation and under the Services section ('Bike Rentals')

Guided rides.detail: 'Cycling Club & Local Rides | Duncan' listed as a named service page in the navigation, and 'Group Rides' also listed under Services
